IEA (2018). The Future of Petrochemicals: Towards more sustainable plastics and fertilisers. Paris: International Energy Agency. https://www.iea.org/reports/the-future-of-petrochemicals

The report's technology data sit in figure notes (Figure 2.6 for HVC routes, Figure 5.17 for ammonia routes); the charts themselves are levelised costs without printed values. Locators are PDF page numbers (the printed Page | N markers agree up to p.85 and drift by one later). Figure 2.6's notes print '14-17 GJ/tHVC for naphtha steam cracking' after '12-19 GJ/tHVC for naphtha steam cracking' - the second is read as ethane (flagged on the row). Most of the report is scenario analysis (RTS/CTS) kept in _sector-intensity.
